summary.text: Brian Stewart is a Republican state representative from Ohio who represents District 12 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An Army veteran, he chairs the House Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Brian Stewart lives in Ashville, Ohio, and served in the U.S. Army.
He earned bachelor's and law degrees from Ohio State University, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including co-owning the law firm Farthing & Stewart LLP.
Stewart assumed office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2023, and Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the House Finance Committee.
In the general election he faces Democrat Lee Yarsky, who replaced Liam N. Strausbaugh on the ballot after Strausbaugh withdrew following his win in the Democratic primary.
